name: Documentation
description: The recording, describing, photographing, writing, or otherwise preserving of studio practice.

name: Observation
description: Close looking, listening, noticing, or attending to visual, material, spatial, or social details.

name: Reflection
description: Thinking back through a process, decision, work, or encounter in order to understand what has changed.

name: Field notes
description: Written, visual, or recorded notes made during observation, research, travel, or site-based practice.

name: Process journal
description: A record of studio activity, decision-making, experimentation, testing, and reflection over time.

name: Visual diary
description: A visual record of images, drawings, notes, references, tests, and developing ideas.

name: Studio log
description: A practical record of studio actions, materials, timings, tests, failures, and outcomes.

name: Annotation
description: Notes or marks added to an image, text, object, or document to explain, question, or interpret it.

name: Recording
description: The capture of sound, image, movement, speech, action, or process using analogue or digital means.

name: Evidence
description: Material, visual, textual, or experiential traces that support an interpretation or account of practice.
